title: Go City: Philadelphia Explorer Pass: Choose 3 to 7 Things To Do
includes: Valid for 30 days from first attraction visit
Free digital guide with attraction information including opening times and instructions
Digital pass valid for three, four, five, or seven attractions, tours or activities
Food and drinks, unless specified (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Go City child passes are only available for ages 3 to 12 years old. For any accompanying children under 3 yrs old please check with each individual attraction or tour whether infants are accepted and/or need to pay an entrance fee.
policies: Your Philadelphia Explorer Pass will be immediately available as your 'ticket' after purchase. Save on your mobile device and use for direct entry into the attractions.

The most popular activities require advanced reservations, check the instructions on the included digital guide, or Go City app, and make sure to place reservations well in advance to avoid disappointment.
Attractions and tours are subject to change. The Go City app has the most up-to-date line-up, opening times and instructions on how to access each attraction.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Save money on some of Philadelphia's best-known attractions with Go City's Philadelphia Explorer Pass. Choose 3, 4, 5, or 7 attractions and tours from over thirty options and visit them within 30 calendar days. With Go City you can enjoy direct entry to attractions, simply save your pass on your mobile device (available as your 'ticket' after purchase) and go – no voucher redemption required!
